profiles.name: full
profiles.label: Full system
profiles.description: Every mechanism in place; no patch.

profiles.name: decl_validation
profiles.label: -Declaration validation
profiles.description: The feature validators run at load (compute, conversation and network declarations, the memory graph check: M-38's proposal export and M-67's minimum version) and the runtime minimum-version gate. Container rules, the base workflow.v0 validator and `memory_declarations` stay: its result is what the graph check and every memory run consume, and a memory run calls it again when it opens (its refusals are kept, as v1 kept parsing).

profiles.name: egress_scan
profiles.label: -Egress scan
profiles.description: M-36's scans of the run's sealed values in a tool's arguments and in a model request (N11). The shared scanner stays: the proposals check (M-40 step 7) uses it too.

profiles.name: proposal_check
profiles.label: -Proposal check
profiles.description: M-40's checks of the proposals document (its schema: the marker line, a supersedes link, the shape; the type declared under memory.write; sealed fields; the update target granted; every link and body link granted; a #n naming another proposal; no sealed value anywhere) and the denied memory.write's `offered: 0`.

profiles.name: module_gate
profiles.label: -Module gate
profiles.description: The static module check (compute.v0 C-19): no imports, exactly one memory with a declared maximum, the memory, alloc and node-function exports with their signatures, the declared SHA-256, and the feature refusals a single line can lift (shared-memory limits, tail calls' return_call, the v128 type). SIMD and atomic instructions are refused inside the decoder (no single-line site); the container rules stay; agentpkg's wasmtime configuration repeats the feature refusals at compile (the engine's own, kept).

profiles.name: compute_limits
profiles.label: -Compute limits
profiles.description: The bounds of a compute call: the host page ceiling (the runtime's preflight and both execution layers' check, and agentpkg's store limit), fuel and the call's wall bound, and the output bounds (zero length, range, size). The node's own timeout stays (a general mechanism): agentpkg's engine then stops at the node timeout plus its grace (B-224), the core terminates the call's Worker when the node times out.

profiles.name: consent_gate
profiles.label: -Consent gate
profiles.description: V-9's per-permission gate before a gated tool, V-13's once spent across turns (the next turn forgets what earlier turns spent: the step is asked again and the tool may use it again), and the transcript-against-plan check's consent_not_authorized. Within a turn, `once` and a denied grant stay (the permission mediator). The transcript check's unknown step stays: without it the check reads the step's permissions of nothing.

profiles.name: conversation_bounds
profiles.label: -Conversation bounds
profiles.description: The conversation's turn cap, its token and remote-call budgets (a turn reserved against what is left), and its per-tool caps across turns (each turn gets the package's per-turn cap again; the per-turn cap itself stays).

profiles.name: transition_check
profiles.label: -Transition check
profiles.description: network.v0's run-time transition checks: the hop cap, an edge's max_uses (model and fixed routes), a role's max_activations, and the write view of a role's patch. The route's enum is enforced by the route answer's own output schema (and its edge lookup), which no profile removes; the read view is structural (a role's environment holds its view only).

profiles.name: envelope_reservation
profiles.label: -Envelope reservation
profiles.description: network.v0's envelope: the worst case against the package's own budget at validation (R-22, tokens and remote calls) and the reservation of the worst case against what the run has left before the first activation (R-17); `network.started` is still recorded.
